title: Give {app} access to your meetings in Simon Says
canSearch: search and read the meetings and recordings you can see in Simon Says, your private ones included
canTasks: see your tasks and tick them off, as when you tick them in the app
canAgenda: add points to the next agenda in a förening, and prepare it if needed
cannotEdit: change or delete notes and minutes
cannotMore: see more than you see in Simon Says
revokeHint: You can disconnect at any time under Account → Connect your AI.
notOpenText: The Claude connection is turned off right now. Try again later.
expiredText: Start the connection again from Claude.
errorTitle: The connection could not be started
errorClient: Simon Says does not recognise the app that tried to connect. Remove the connection in Claude and add it again.
errorRedirect: The app tried to send you to an address it has not registered. It was stopped for your safety.
panelIntro: Ask your AI about your meetings, decisions and tasks. It only sees what you see, and you can disconnect at any time.
revokeConfirm: {client} will no longer reach your meetings. You can connect again at any time.
revokeFailed: It couldn't be disconnected. Try again.
auditIntro: What the assistants did: tool and time, never content.
localWarning: Access goes to a program on this computer (for example Claude Code). Only allow it if you just started the connection yourself.
unknownWarning: Simon Says does not recognise where the access would go, so it can't be allowed.
tryIt: Try it: ask “What did we decide at the last meeting?”

claude.1: Open Claude and go to Customize → Connectors.
claude.2: Click + Add and choose Add custom connector.
claude.3: Name it Simon Says and paste the address:
claude.4: Click Connect, sign in with Google and allow.

chatgpt.note: Needs ChatGPT Business, Enterprise or Edu, on the web. On Business an admin adds it.
chatgpt.2: Click + and choose Add custom MCP server.
chatgpt.3: Name it Simon Says and paste the address under Connection:
chatgpt.4: Choose OAuth for sign-in, tick I understand and want to continue and click Create as a plugin.
chatgpt.5: Sign in with Google and allow.

cursor.1: Click Add to Cursor. Cursor opens and asks whether to install simon-says.
cursor.2: Install it, then sign in with Google when Cursor asks, and allow.
cursor.3: Link not working? Add this to Cursor's mcp.json:

vscode.1: Click Add to VS Code and choose Install.
vscode.2: Start simon-says and allow the sign-in when VS Code asks.
vscode.3: Sign in with Google and allow. Then ask in Copilot Chat, in agent mode.

claude-code.2: Start Claude Code, type /mcp, choose simon-says and then Authenticate.
claude-code.3: Sign in with Google and allow in the browser.

gemini.2: Type /mcp auth simon-says in Gemini CLI.
gemini.3: Sign in with Google and allow in the browser.
